nodes.title: Prompt
nodes.help: The text the workflow starts from.

nodes.title: Seed
nodes.help: The noise seed; -1 picks a random one, reported with the result.

nodes.title: Canvas
nodes.help: The video size in pixels, on the 64 px grid of two-stage LTX (stage 1 runs at half of it). About 0.1 to 2.1 MP.

nodes.title: Duration
nodes.help: The clip's length in frames on LTX's 8k + 1 grid, and its frame rate (fps changes the generated motion, not only playback).

params.name: frames
params.label: Length
params.help: Auto: the model predicts the length from the prompt, 1 to 20 s (at most 321 frames), reported with the result.

params.name: fps
params.label: Frame rate
params.help: LTX was trained at 24; values far from it drift.

nodes.title: LTX-2.5
nodes.help: Which weights to load and at what precision.

params.name: variant
params.label: Variant
params.help: Distilled: 8 steps without guidance, about 10× faster. Dev: guided steps, CFG and STG, and Extend before (retake, extend, audio to video). fp8 / int8: smaller community weights, NVIDIA hosts only.

params.name: precision
params.label: Precision
params.help: Quantized at load: int8 about 19 GB for the transformer, bf16 about 38 GB.

params.name: compute
params.label: Compute
params.help: float16 runs attention and feed-forward in half precision: 10–20 % faster, the picture changes slightly. NVIDIA ignores it.

nodes.title: LoRA Stack
nodes.help: Applies LoRAs to the model's transformer, in order. Empty: the model as it is.

params.name: rows
params.label: LoRAs

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Adapter: applied at run time, a strength change needs no reload. Bake: merged at load.

params.help: Each row: a LoRA that fits this model and its strength.

nodes.title: Encode
nodes.help: Encodes the prompt (and its beats, as one prompt) for video and audio with Gemma 4 and the connector, and a negative prompt for NAG; the text encoder is unloaded before sampling.

params.name: beats
params.label: Prompt beats

seconds.label: Length
seconds.help: How long this beat lasts, in seconds; 0 shares what the others leave equally.

params.help: Prompt Relay: each beat steers the picture and the sound for its stretch of the clip, in order; the prompt above holds for the whole clip.

params.name: negative
params.label: Negative prompt
params.help: What the clip should not show, applied with NAG (about 10 % slower). Empty: off. Mac only.

nodes.title: Keyframes
nodes.help: Pins gallery images at chosen times of the clip: at 0 s the clip starts from the image, later ones are frames it passes through. Bypassed: text to video.

params.name: images
params.label: Frames

seconds.label: At
seconds.help: Where in the clip, in seconds: 0 is the first frame, the clip's length its last.

strength.label: Strength
strength.help: 1 holds the frame to the image; lower lets the model drift from it.

binding.label: Binding
binding.help: Auto: a frame at 0 s replaces the start, later ones guide. Replace pins the frame exactly. Guide lets the clip pass near it.

params.help: Each row: an image, where it goes, how strongly it holds and how it binds.

nodes.title: Sample
nodes.help: Denoises video and audio together. Stage 1 starts from the seed's noise at half size (canvas and duration); stage 2 refines an upscaled latent at full size (latent).

params.name: role
params.label: Stage
params.help: stage1: half size, ancestral sampler, 8 steps. stage2: full size from latent, renoised at 0.909, 3 steps.

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.help: Fixed by the stage's distilled schedule: stage 1 runs 8 steps, stage 2 runs 3 (fewer would stop with noise left in).

params.name: detail
params.label: Detail pass
params.help: Stage 1 pads the clip to whole 24 or 32 frame segments with a generated keyframe slot at each boundary; stage 2 refines with them and the IC-LoRA's reference (stage 1's latent), keeps stage 1's sound and trims the padding. Distilled only; Mac only.

nodes.title: IC-LoRA
nodes.help: Attaches the model's IC-LoRA to the transformer as a run-time adapter; a sampler fed a reference refines against it. Bypassed: the model as it is.

nodes.title: Upscale latent
nodes.help: Doubles the video latent's width and height with the spatial upsampler; the audio latent passes through.

nodes.title: Decode
nodes.help: Decodes video and audio and writes an MP4 (H.264 + AAC 48 kHz stereo) with a poster frame; a clip made from source audio carries that audio, trimmed to the clip.

params.name: audio
params.label: Audio
params.help: Off: an MP4 without a sound track. The picture is the same: the model always generates both.

nodes.title: Encode (guided)
nodes.help: Encodes the prompt and, for Dev's guided samplers, the negative prompt (typed, else the fixed one) for video and audio with Gemma 4 and the connector (Distilled: the prompt only); the text encoder is unloaded before sampling.

params.name: negative
params.label: Negative prompt
params.help: What the clip should not show, for Dev's guidance (CFG). Empty: the fixed negative prompt. Distilled ignores this.

nodes.title: Source video
nodes.help: Encodes a gallery video and its sound with the video and audio VAEs, at its own size and frame rate; its length is floored to 8k + 1 frames.

params.name: source
params.label: Source video
params.help: A video whose sides are multiples of 32, at most 321 frames.

nodes.title: Source audio
nodes.help: Encodes a stretch of a gallery audio take (or a video's sound) at 16 kHz stereo; the clip lasts as long as that stretch, floored to 8k + 1 frames (at most 321).

params.name: source
params.label: Audio
params.help: An audio take, or a video with sound; in and out pick the part the clip follows (at most 13.375 s: 321 frames at 24 fps).

params.name: fps
params.label: Frame rate
params.help: Audio to video runs at 24 fps.

nodes.title: Retake
nodes.help: Regenerates a stretch of the source clip (and, unless kept, its sound): Dev with guidance, Distilled in its 8 steps without; the rest of the clip is kept as context. The result is the whole clip.

params.name: span
params.label: Retake
params.help: The stretch to regenerate, snapped to LTX's 8-frame latent grid.

params.name: audio
params.label: Regenerate audio
params.help: Off: the sound is not regenerated (it is re-encoded through the audio VAE).

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.help: Euler steps of the guided loop; each runs the model four times over the whole clip. Distilled runs its own 8 steps and ignores this.

params.name: cfg
params.label: CFG
params.help: How strongly the prompt is followed against the fixed negative prompt. Distilled ignores this.

params.name: stg
params.label: STG
params.help: Spatio-temporal guidance (block 28 skipped); 0 turns it off. Distilled ignores this.

nodes.title: Extend
nodes.help: Generates new frames (and sound) after or before the source clip. Dev: guided, with the whole clip as context. Distilled: after only, two stages over the clip's last 25 frames and the new part (sides on a 64 px grid). The result is the whole extended clip.

params.name: seconds
params.label: Add
params.help: Seconds to add, rounded up to whole 8-frame steps.

values_by.note: Dev: the only model that extends before. About 10× slower.

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.help: Euler steps of the guided loop; each runs the model four times over the whole clip. Distilled runs its own 8 steps and ignores this.

params.name: cfg
params.label: CFG
params.help: How strongly the prompt is followed against the fixed negative prompt. Distilled ignores this.

params.name: stg
params.label: STG
params.help: Spatio-temporal guidance (block 28 skipped); 0 turns it off. Distilled ignores this.

nodes.title: Sample (guided)
nodes.help: Stage 1 of audio to video: denoises the video at half size (Dev with guidance, Distilled in its 8 steps) while the source audio stays fixed and steers it.

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.help: Euler steps of the guided loop; each runs the model four times over the whole clip. Distilled runs its own 8 steps and ignores this.

params.name: cfg
params.label: CFG
params.help: How strongly the prompt is followed against the fixed negative prompt. Distilled ignores this.

params.name: stg
params.label: STG
params.help: Spatio-temporal guidance (block 28 skipped); 0 turns it off. Distilled ignores this.

params.name: detail
params.label: Detail pass
params.help: As text to video's: the padded canvas with keyframe slots, the source audio padded with silence. Distilled only; Mac only.

nodes.title: Distilled LoRA
nodes.help: Fuses the distilled LoRA into the dev transformer at strength 1, so a stage-2 sampler can refine with the distilled schedule. Distilled has it fused in: passed through.

nodes.title: Output
nodes.help: Stores its input as a run output: an image, a video or (from API 1.30) an audio take.
